about.title: About
about.intro1: I'm an intern in physiology/performance with youth academy categories, and day-to-day I cover the data and technology demand: processing GPS, building load and wellness dashboards, generating reports, and maintaining the internal tools coaching staff actually use.
about.intro2: Every project on this site is evidence of what I already ship in practice — pipelines, local databases, sync and reports — on the path toward data engineering, not as a job title I don't hold yet.
about.intro3: Outside work, I run Claude Code and Cursor in a loop until the feature is ready, review the diff before merge, and build personal tools with local AI and mandatory human-in-the-loop approval, like a Telegram agenda bot.
about.domain1: GPS and training load (session metrics, week-over-week, targets)
about.domain2: Wellness: Hooper Index, post-training RPE, adherence
about.domain4: Pipelines: raw files → local database → cloud (always upsert)
about.formation1: Physical Education — UFRJ (expected graduation by year end)
about.formation2: Systems Analysis and Development — FGV (2nd semester)
about.formation3: Asimov Academy: Python Office (Automations + Python for Business), Intermediate Concepts, CursorAI; AI Agents Engineer track (in progress)
about.aiIntro: I describe myself as an AI-assisted developer: I model the problem and architecture, and agents (Cursor and Claude Code) speed up implementation — architectural decisions and review stay with me, never autonomous. UI and front-end layers ship this way; my strength is product, sports-data domain, and orchestration with human review.
about.disclaimer: Working style: agent loop until the feature lands → review the diff and decide merge → skills, rules and CLAUDE.md → vault memory (raw sources → wiki/log). I don't claim live React/JS fluency or an AI engineer title.
about.aiSkillsDesc: I maintain skills, rules, CLAUDE.md and hooks so the same agent workflow repeats across projects — agent-led implementation, without claiming a formal PRD on every step.
about.aiKnowledgeDesc: I keep a personal base with raw sources separated from a curated layer (wiki), plus a dated change log — so agents work from reliable information, not loose context.
about.aiPlanningDesc: Larger builds follow session-based execution, with done-criteria per stage and handoff between sessions — this site itself was built that way (Fable / Claude Code).
about.aiSafetyDesc: In local-AI projects, every action goes through human approval (human-in-the-loop). Diff review is the gate before merge; model outputs are validated before becoming the final result (see Local AI Agent and Personal Ops).

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Six real systems — three from the football domain (demos use fictional data only) and three personal. Each with a full case study; most with an interactive demo.

gps-load-dashboard.title: GPS & Load Dashboard
gps-load-dashboard.description: Full-stack GPS, wellness and strength platform for youth academy categories: local-first pipeline, Next.js + FastAPI + SQLite, upsert sync to the cloud and client-side PDF.

performance-hub.title: Multi-department Performance Hub
performance-hub.description: Multi-department dashboard in production (Streamlit + SQLite): physiology, medicine and multidisciplinary areas in one app, with self-service imports and per-athlete PDF.

evaluations-hub.title: Academy Evaluations Hub
evaluations-hub.description: Evaluations and attendance hub (Next.js + Supabase): per-department calendar, weekly compliance and read-only GPS data through a shared database.

local-ai-agent.title: Local AI Agent (Human-in-the-Loop)
local-ai-agent.description: Desktop agent (Tauri + Rust) with a local LLM via Ollama: the model only proposes actions; everything goes through an approval queue with diffs, file sandboxing and an audit log.

personal-ops.title: Personal Ops + Telegram Bot
personal-ops.description: Personal agenda (Flask + JSON, no build step) with a Telegram conversation bot on a local LLM — mandatory confirmation before writes and anti-hallucination enforced in code.

jarvis-assistente-voz.title: Jarvis — Personal Voice Assistant
jarvis-assistente-voz.description: Local voice assistant (plain HTML/JS + Node server) with a graph-based Second Brain, agenda via its own API, email triage and two AI engines — cloud or fully local.

lab.title: Personal projects
lab.lead: Sports Data in football is my primary lane. Over here, personal projects where I practice AI agent orchestration and assisted development — always with human approval before any action, never in autonomous mode.
